items.q: While the voter turnout is disappointing, I am hopeful more North Dakotans will become civically engaged and vote in future elections.

record.t: Announced that his office is accepting nominations for the 2026 North Dakota Election Hero Award.
record.q: North Dakota Secretary of State Michael Howe is accepting nominations for the 2026 North Dakota Election Hero Award.

record.t: Became North Dakota's 15th Secretary of State on January 1, 2023.
record.q: Michael and his wife, Katie, married a year before he became North Dakota’s 15 th Secretary of State on January 1, 2023.

record.t: Served as State Representative from District 22, representing rural Cass County in the North Dakota Legislature, for six years before becoming Secretary of State.
record.q: Michael served rural Cass County in the North Dakota Legislature for six years as State Representative from District 22, prior to becoming Secretary of State.

record.t: Was appointed to the House Appropriations Committee in his second legislative session and served as chairman of the interim Government Finance Committee.
record.q: In his second legislative session, he was appointed to the House Appropriations Committee and served as chairman of the interim Government Finance Committee.

record.t: Serves on state boards including the Board of University and School Lands, Emergency Commission, State Historical Board and State Canvassing Board.
record.q: As North Dakota Secretary of State, he also serves on the following state boards: Board of University and School Lands, Emergency Commission, State Historical Board, State Canvassing Board, Theodore Roosevelt Rough Rider Award.

record.t: Announced plans to appeal Judge Welte's November ruling, citing a new 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruling.
record.q: Days after Welte’s November ruling, Howe announced his plans to appeal, citing a new 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruling that private individuals and groups such as the NAACP can’t sue under a critical section of the landmark civil rights law.

record.t: Requested a delay of the November ruling pending appeal; Welte and the 8th Circuit denied the requests.
record.q: Welte and the 8th Circuit denied Howe's requests to delay the November ruling pending appeal.
